repository_role: cross-program development lane hosted in fcp; intended for later independent paper/repository if source qualification succeeds

motivating_anchors.chun: evolutionary-time proof of concept: phenotype similarity decays with relative phylogenetic divergence and carrying resolution is radiation-specific
motivating_anchors.fcp: geographic-space proof of concept: within-species phenotype is locally organized without one universal global transition map

core_question: Do the same biological properties predict how rapidly biological state information is lost across evolutionary time and geographic space, and does the same architecture extend from organismal traits to biotic interactions?

canonical_response.name: null_centered_turnover_rho
canonical_response.definition: delta_rho = Spearman(separation, state_dissimilarity) - mean(Spearman under the axis-specific frozen null)
canonical_response.direction: larger positive delta_rho means faster turnover / faster memory loss with increasing separation
canonical_response.comparability_rule: effect size, not null z-score, is the cross-system response; null SD is retained only as an informativeness diagnostic

axis_scaling.evolutionary_time: relative patristic separation normalized within the declared system; absolute-time claims require an independently dated tree
axis_scaling.geographic_space: great-circle distance; rank correlation makes absolute distance units irrelevant to the primary effect

trait_time.state: one predeclared trait, continuous or categorical, evaluated separately rather than concatenating arbitrary traits
trait_time.dissimilarity: absolute standardized difference for scalar continuous traits; 0/1 mismatch for categorical traits; Euclidean only for biologically predeclared multivariate trait modules
trait_time.null: permute complete species-level trait states among eligible tips within the clade

trait_space.state: the same predeclared trait used in trait_time
trait_space.unit: clade × trait, built from repeated georeferenced measurements within species
trait_space.dissimilarity: same trait dissimilarity definition as trait_time
trait_space.separation: great-circle distance among measurements within species
trait_space.null: permute complete trait rows among observed coordinates within species
trait_space.aggregation: estimate one within-species delta_rho, then equal-species median within clade × trait; species are not pseudo-replicates of evolutionary time

interaction_time.state: availability-conditioned partner profile of a focal taxon
interaction_time.dissimilarity: Jensen-Shannon distance of normalized partner profiles after applying the predeclared co-opportunity rule
interaction_time.separation: relative patristic distance among focal taxa
interaction_time.null: permute complete partner-profile rows among focal taxa within the admissible co-opportunity stratum, preserving each profile's degree/weight distribution
interaction_time.aggregation: one effect per network programme × focal guild

interaction_space.state: pairwise interaction realization across replicated sites/networks
interaction_space.dissimilarity: primary = rewiring component among species jointly available to the compared networks; total interaction beta diversity and species-turnover component are retained separately
interaction_space.null: site-label/edge realization null that preserves the frozen local species/partner opportunity sets and declared interaction marginals
interaction_space.aggregation: one effect per network programme × interaction type

interaction_decomposition.reason: interaction turnover caused only by partner disappearance is not equivalent to changed partner choice among available species

context_heterogeneity.concept: heterogeneity in abiotic conditions and/or biotic partner opportunity experienced by the declared system
context_heterogeneity.prediction: higher heterogeneity predicts larger turnover effects on both evolutionary-time and geographic-space axes
context_heterogeneity.measurement_rule: freeze one source-derived standardized heterogeneity score per system before response effects are opened; do not select among alternative climate/biotic heterogeneity metrics by outcome fit

ecological_specialization.prediction: specialization may strengthen temporal retention while amplifying spatial turnover when local opportunity changes; therefore an opposite-sign time/space coefficient is a predeclared biologically meaningful outcome, not a failure
ecological_specialization.measurement_rule: use source-native breadth or entropy metrics; harmonize sign so higher = more specialized

dispersal_mobility.concept: capacity for spatial mixing among local contexts
dispersal_mobility.prediction: higher mobility should reduce geographic turnover more strongly than evolutionary-time turnover
dispersal_mobility.measurement_rule: taxon-group-specific proxies are z-scored only within declared taxonomic groups; no raw-unit pooling across plants, insects, birds or mammals

H1_common_coupling.test: Across eligible systems, null-centered turnover in evolutionary time positively covaries with null-centered turnover in geographic space.
H1_common_coupling.pooling_rule: estimate trait and interaction strata separately first; combine only in a hierarchical synthesis after both have >=12 independent system units

H2_context_common_driver.test: The predeclared context-heterogeneity predictor has coefficients in the same positive quadrant for time and space turnover.
H2_context_common_driver.decision_geometry: joint bivariate coefficient region; do not replace with two separately cherry-picked univariate significant tests

H3_specialization_decoupling.test: Specialization is allowed to occupy a predeclared opposite-sign time/space quadrant; this tests whether the same biological property can systematically decouple rather than couple the two axes.

H4_interaction_generalization.test: After species-turnover opportunity is removed, interaction rewiring shows a time-space coupling architecture analogous to organismal trait turnover.
H4_interaction_generalization.interaction_type_moderator: mutualistic vs antagonistic/consumer-resource source labels are frozen before outcomes; interaction type is a moderator, not a source-selection criterion

trait_system.requirement: same trait definition and taxonomic crosswalk must support both time and space arms; otherwise the system may inform one arm but not H1/H2

interaction_system.requirement: network programme must expose taxon identities, interaction type, replicated network/site identity, and geography before edge outcomes are admitted

informativeness.rule: before biological response opening, run known-truth simulations on the observed support geometry and require median absolute recovery error <=0.10 in delta_rho and >=80% directional recovery for a benchmark delta_rho=0.15

phylogeny.plants: dated vascular-plant megatree such as V.PhyloMaker2/GBOTB, with attachment status tracked and sensitivity excluding taxonomy-inserted tips
phylogeny.nonplants: source-specific dated trees preferred; Open Tree may be used for taxonomy/crosswalk but not treated as calibrated time without valid branch lengths

hard_nonclaims: no universal turnover law is assumed
no claim that temporal and spatial turnover are generated by the same mechanism unless the common-driver tests pass
no claim that network turnover equals rewiring unless species turnover is explicitly removed
no pooling of null z-scores as biological effect sizes
no treating species within one clade/network programme as independent macroevolutionary replicates
no use of current CHUN/FCP flower-colour outcomes to choose generalized traits, networks or predictors
